title: Recharged material metadata (schema v1)
description: Per-material semantic metadata. Auto-derivation may PROPOSE these values; committed files are authoritative overrides. Ambiguous fields (alpha_mode, map semantics) must never be inferred from PNG channel count alone.

id.description: Stable identifier, independent of physical file names: <game>/<tpage>/<name>

original.description: The in-game texture this material replaces.

combo_id.description: (tpage << 16) | texid, when known from an extraction run

has_alpha.description: Whether the ORIGINAL texture carries meaningful alpha — guards against shipping an opaque replacement for a transparent original

esrgan_dims.description: Dimensions of the corresponding texture in the reference ESRGAN pack (metadata only; those PNGs are never imported)

required.description: Functionally mandatory content (missing it is an error, not a cosmetic downgrade)

levels.description: tpage names using this material (derived from placements.json)

variant_of.description: Canonical material id when this set is a 'recale' pixel variant

maps.description: One entry per shipped map of this material.

mip_policy.description: Overrides of the semantic defaults (see docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md D7).

coverage_threshold.description: Alpha-coverage target for cutout mips (engine AREF semantics)

format_overrides.description: Per-profile format overrides, keyed by profile id then map kind.

colorspace.description: srgb-encoded = filtered in linear light offline, stored as encoded values, decoded by the shader (pow 2.2); linear = data map, filtered and stored linear

channels.description: Channels carrying real data (normals ship rg = X/Y with Z reconstructed in-shader)
